description: Kotlin class 'OpenAiTrashTalker' that provides functionality to generate playful trash talk messages for a Tic Tac Toe game by interfacing with the OpenAI API. It manages API key resolution, constructs prompts, and handles API communication, providing friendly fallback messages when needed.

classes.name: OpenAiTrashTalker
classes.description: Class responsible for generating playful trash talk messages using OpenAI's API, aimed at enhancing user engagement in a Tic Tac Toe Android app.

methods.name: generateTrashTalk
methods.description: Main method to generate a playful, short trash talk line based on the current game state. Uses API key resolution and fallback messaging.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt string sent to the OpenAI API, including game context and outcome information.

methods.name: callOpenAI
methods.description: Handles the HTTP connection to OpenAI API, sending the prompt, and parsing the response.

methods.name: resolveApiKey
methods.description: Attempts to find the OpenAI API key via BuildConfig, AndroidManifest meta-data, or environment variables.
